title: Phone: Objectives button next to Players and Events
description: The two buttons at the bottom right of the phone layout (Players, Events) are joined by an Objectives button that opens the same Objectives dialog as the top menu. Before shots are taken on the commit without it; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CC. Mocked fixtures.

shots.heading: After: 360x740
shots.caption: All three buttons fit in the viewport.

notes.title: Where
notes.text: GameShell gets an optional onOpenObjectives prop (App passes it); the button sits in .app-shell__mobile-actions and closes any open drawer first.
